title: Skeptical CFO Discovery Call - ROI Pushback

customer_profile.name: Ravi Mehta
customer_profile.opening_message: I’ll be direct — why should I spend on this now? What’s the ROI and payback?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent runs strong discovery, frames ROI conservatively with assumptions (no invented numbers), and proposes a pilot with measurable success metrics and timeline
customer_profile.personality_notes: Cares about payback window, risk reduction, and credible measurement; dislikes fluff and unverified claims.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge skepticism and confirm what ROI/payback means to the CFO
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Ask what payback window and outcomes (hard savings vs risk) matter most.

checkpoints.description: Ask at least 3 targeted discovery questions about current costs/risks
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Probe time spent, rework/error costs, delays, headcount, compliance risk.

checkpoints.description: Summarize CFO priorities and restate success criteria in business terms
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Reflect their goals (payback + risk) before presenting any value frame.

checkpoints.description: Frame value conservatively with explicit assumptions (no invented benchmarks)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: State assumptions and ask for inputs; avoid guaranteed savings.

checkpoints.description: Propose a pilot/POC with metrics, owners, and timeline; ask for the next meeting
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer a measurable pilot and schedule the next step/workshop.

positive_reinforcement_triggers: Pilot proposal with metrics and owners

scenario_context: CFO discovery call. Must ask discovery first, quantify value conservatively with stated assumptions, and avoid invented benchmarks or guaranteed ROI. End with a pilot proposal (metrics + timeline + owners).
